CLASS ltcl_probe DEFINITION FINAL FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv TYPE string.
    METHODS add IMPORTING iv_case TYPE string iv_value TYPE string.
    METHODS exc IMPORTING iv_case TYPE string ix TYPE REF TO cx_root.
    METHODS report IMPORTING iv_point TYPE string.
    METHODS p1_xrepl FOR TESTING.
    METHODS p2_xfind FOR TESTING.
    METHODS p3_iovf FOR TESTING.
    METHODS p4_x4i FOR TESTING.
    METHODS p5_pack FOR TESTING.
    METHODS p7_gensub FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_probe IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add.
    mv = mv && iv_case && '=' && iv_value && ';'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD exc.
    DATA lv_name TYPE string.
    lv_name = cl_abap_classdescr=>get_class_name( ix ).
    REPLACE '\CLASS=' IN lv_name WITH ''.
    add( iv_case = iv_case iv_value = lv_name ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD report.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = iv_point detail = mv quit = if_aunit_constants=>method ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD p3_iovf.
    DATA: lv_max  TYPE i VALUE 2147483647,
          lv_min  TYPE i,
          lv_i    TYPE i,
          lv_two  TYPE i VALUE 2,
          lv_m1   TYPE i VALUE -1,
          lv_p    TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 0,
          lv_p1   TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 1,
          lv_f    TYPE f,
          lv_c    TYPE c LENGTH 12,
          lv_s    TYPE string,
          lv_8    TYPE int8,
          lv_8max TYPE int8 VALUE 9223372036854775807,
          lx      TYPE REF TO cx_root.
    lv_min = -2147483647.
    lv_min = lv_min - 1.
    add( iv_case = 'min' iv_value = |{ lv_min }| ).
    TRY.
    lv_i = lv_max + 1.
    add( iv_case = 'max+1' iv_value = |{ lv_i }| ).
    CATCH cx_root INTO lx.
    exc( iv_case = 'max+1' ix = lx ).
    ENDTRY.
    TRY.
    lv_i = lv_min - 1.
    add( iv_case = 'min-1' iv_value = |{ lv_i }| ).
    CATCH cx_root INTO lx.
    exc( iv_case = 'min-1' ix = lx ).
    ENDTRY.
    TRY.
    lv_i = lv_max.
    ADD 1 TO lv_i.
    add( iv_case = 'ADD' iv_value = |{ lv_i }| ).
    CATCH cx_root INTO lx.
    exc( iv_case = 'ADD' ix = lx ).
    ENDTRY.
    TRY.
    lv_i = lv_max * lv_two.
    add( iv_case = 'max*2' iv_value = |{ lv_i }| ).
    CATCH cx_root INTO lx.
    exc( iv_case = 'max*2' ix = lx ).
    ENDTRY.
    TRY.
    lv_i = lv_max.
    MULTIPLY lv_i BY 2.
    add( iv_case = 'MULTIPLY' iv_value = |{ lv_i }| ).
    CATCH cx_root INTO lx.
    exc( iv_case = 'MULTIPLY' ix = lx ).
    ENDTRY.
    TRY.
    lv_i = lv_min * lv_m1.
    add( iv_case = 'min*-1' iv_value = |{ lv_i }| ).
    CATCH cx_root INTO lx.
    exc( iv_case = 'min*-1' ix = lx ).
    ENDTRY.
    TRY.
    lv_i = lv_min DIV lv_m1.
    add( iv_case = 'min DIV -1' iv_value = |{ lv_i }| ).
    CATCH cx_root INTO lx.
    exc( iv_case = 'min DIV -1' ix = lx ).
    ENDTRY.
    TRY.
    lv_i = lv_min MOD lv_m1.
    add( iv_case = 'min MOD -1' iv_value = |{ lv_i }| ).
    CATCH cx_root INTO lx.
    exc( iv_case = 'min MOD -1' ix = lx ).
    ENDTRY.
    TRY.
    lv_i = abs( lv_min ).
    add( iv_case = 'abs(min)' iv_value = |{ lv_i }| ).
    CATCH cx_root INTO lx.
    exc( iv_case = 'abs(min)' ix = lx ).
    ENDTRY.
    TRY.
    lv_i = 0 - lv_min.
    add( iv_case = '0-min' iv_value = |{ lv_i }| ).
    CATCH cx_root INTO lx.
    exc( iv_case = '0-min' ix = lx ).
    ENDTRY.
    TRY.
    lv_p = lv_max + 1.
    add( iv_case = 'p=max+1' iv_value = |{ lv_p }| ).
    CATCH cx_root INTO lx.
    exc( iv_case = 'p=max+1' ix = lx ).
    ENDTRY.
    TRY.
    lv_p = 1.
    lv_i = lv_max + lv_p.
    add( iv_case = 'i=max+p' iv_value = |{ lv_i }| ).
    CATCH cx_root INTO lx.
    exc( iv_case = 'i=max+p' ix = lx ).
    ENDTRY.
    TRY.
    lv_8 = lv_max + 1.
    add( iv_case = 'int8=max+1' iv_value = |{ lv_8 }| ).
    CATCH cx_root INTO lx.
    exc( iv_case = 'int8=max+1' ix = lx ).
    ENDTRY.
    TRY.
    lv_8 = lv_8max + 1.
    add( iv_case = 'int8max+1' iv_value = |{ lv_8 }| ).
    CATCH cx_root INTO lx.
    exc( iv_case = 'int8max+1' ix = lx ).
    ENDTRY.
    TRY.
    lv_8 = 3000000000.
    lv_i = lv_8.
    add( iv_case = 'i=int8 3e9' iv_value = |{ lv_i }| ).
    CATCH cx_root INTO lx.
    exc( iv_case = 'i=int8 3e9' ix = lx ).
    ENDTRY.
    TRY.
    lv_f = '3E9'.
    lv_i = lv_f.
    add( iv_case = 'i=f 3e9' iv_value = |{ lv_i }| ).
    CATCH cx_root INTO lx.
    exc( iv_case = 'i=f 3e9' ix = lx ).
    ENDTRY.
    TRY.
    lv_f = '-3E9'.
    lv_i = lv_f.
    add( iv_case = 'i=f -3e9' iv_value = |{ lv_i }| ).
    CATCH cx_root INTO lx.
    exc( iv_case = 'i=f -3e9' ix = lx ).
    ENDTRY.
    TRY.
    lv_f = '2147483647.5'.
    lv_i = lv_f.
    add( iv_case = 'i=f max.5' iv_value = |{ lv_i }| ).
    CATCH cx_root INTO lx.
    exc( iv_case = 'i=f max.5' ix = lx ).
    ENDTRY.
    TRY.
    lv_f = '2147483647.4'.
    lv_i = lv_f.
    add( iv_case = 'i=f max.4' iv_value = |{ lv_i }| ).
    CATCH cx_root INTO lx.
    exc( iv_case = 'i=f max.4' ix = lx ).
    ENDTRY.
    TRY.
    lv_f = '-2147483648.5'.
    lv_i = lv_f.
    add( iv_case = 'i=f min.5' iv_value = |{ lv_i }| ).
    CATCH cx_root INTO lx.
    exc( iv_case = 'i=f min.5' ix = lx ).
    ENDTRY.
    TRY.
    lv_p = 3000000000.
    lv_i = lv_p.
    add( iv_case = 'i=p 3e9' iv_value = |{ lv_i }| ).
    CATCH cx_root INTO lx.
    exc( iv_case = 'i=p 3e9' ix = lx ).
    ENDTRY.
    TRY.
    lv_p1 = '2147483647.5'.
    lv_i = lv_p1.
    add( iv_case = 'i=p max.5' iv_value = |{ lv_i }| ).
    CATCH cx_root INTO lx.
    exc( iv_case = 'i=p max.5' ix = lx ).
    ENDTRY.
    TRY.
    lv_p1 = '-2147483648.4'.
    lv_i = lv_p1.
    add( iv_case = 'i=p min.4' iv_value = |{ lv_i }| ).
    CATCH cx_root INTO lx.
    exc( iv_case = 'i=p min.4' ix = lx ).
    ENDTRY.
    TRY.
    lv_p1 = '-2147483648.5'.
    lv_i = lv_p1.
    add( iv_case = 'i=p min.5' iv_value = |{ lv_i }| ).
    CATCH cx_root INTO lx.
    exc( iv_case = 'i=p min.5' ix = lx ).
    ENDTRY.
    TRY.
    lv_c = '3000000000'.
    lv_i = lv_c.
    add( iv_case = 'i=c 3e9' iv_value = |{ lv_i }| ).
    CATCH cx_root INTO lx.
    exc( iv_case = 'i=c 3e9' ix = lx ).
    ENDTRY.
    TRY.
    lv_s = `2147483648`.
    lv_i = lv_s.
    add( iv_case = 'i=string max+1' iv_value = |{ lv_i }| ).
    CATCH cx_root INTO lx.
    exc( iv_case = 'i=string max+1' ix = lx ).
    ENDTRY.
    lv_i = 7 / 2. add( iv_case = '7/2' iv_value = |{ lv_i }| ).
    lv_i = -7 / 2. add( iv_case = '-7/2' iv_value = |{ lv_i }| ).
    lv_i = 5 / 2. add( iv_case = '5/2' iv_value = |{ lv_i }| ).
    lv_i = -5 / 2. add( iv_case = '-5/2' iv_value = |{ lv_i }| ).
    lv_i = 7 DIV -2. add( iv_case = '7 DIV -2' iv_value = |{ lv_i }| ).
    lv_i = 7 MOD -2. add( iv_case = '7 MOD -2' iv_value = |{ lv_i }| ).
    lv_i = -7 DIV 2. add( iv_case = '-7 DIV 2' iv_value = |{ lv_i }| ).
    lv_i = -7 MOD 2. add( iv_case = '-7 MOD 2' iv_value = |{ lv_i }| ).
    TRY.
    lv_i = lv_max.
    lv_i = lv_i / 0.
    add( iv_case = 'i/0' iv_value = |{ lv_i }| ).
    CATCH cx_root INTO lx.
    exc( iv_case = 'i/0' ix = lx ).
    ENDTRY.
    TRY.
    lv_i = 0.
    lv_i = lv_i / 0.
    add( iv_case = '0/0' iv_value = |{ lv_i }| ).
    CATCH cx_root INTO lx.
    exc( iv_case = '0/0' ix = lx ).
    ENDTRY.
    report( 'P3' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD p4_x4i.
    DATA: lv_x1 TYPE x LENGTH 1,
          lv_x2 TYPE x LENGTH 2,
          lv_x4 TYPE x LENGTH 4,
          lv_x8 TYPE x LENGTH 8,
          lv_xs TYPE xstring,
          lv_i  TYPE i,
          lv_8  TYPE int8,
          lx    TYPE REF TO cx_root.
    lv_x4 = '80000000'. lv_i = lv_x4. add( iv_case = 'i=x4 80000000' iv_value = |{ lv_i }| ).
    lv_x4 = '7FFFFFFF'. lv_i = lv_x4. add( iv_case = 'i=x4 7FFFFFFF' iv_value = |{ lv_i }| ).
    lv_x4 = 'FFFFFFFF'. lv_i = lv_x4. add( iv_case = 'i=x4 FFFFFFFF' iv_value = |{ lv_i }| ).
    lv_x4 = '00000100'. lv_i = lv_x4. add( iv_case = 'i=x4 00000100' iv_value = |{ lv_i }| ).
    lv_i = -1. lv_x4 = lv_i. add( iv_case = 'x4=i -1' iv_value = |{ lv_x4 }| ).
    lv_i = -2147483647. lv_i = lv_i - 1. lv_x4 = lv_i. add( iv_case = 'x4=i min' iv_value = |{ lv_x4 }| ).
    lv_i = 256. lv_x4 = lv_i. add( iv_case = 'x4=i 256' iv_value = |{ lv_x4 }| ).
    lv_x2 = 'FFFF'. lv_i = lv_x2. add( iv_case = 'i=x2 FFFF' iv_value = |{ lv_i }| ).
    lv_x2 = '8000'. lv_i = lv_x2. add( iv_case = 'i=x2 8000' iv_value = |{ lv_i }| ).
    lv_i = -1. lv_x2 = lv_i. add( iv_case = 'x2=i -1' iv_value = |{ lv_x2 }| ).
    TRY.
    lv_i = 65536.
    lv_x2 = lv_i.
    add( iv_case = 'x2=i 65536' iv_value = |{ lv_x2 }| ).
    CATCH cx_root INTO lx.
    exc( iv_case = 'x2=i 65536' ix = lx ).
    ENDTRY.
    lv_x1 = 'FF'. lv_i = lv_x1. add( iv_case = 'i=x1 FF' iv_value = |{ lv_i }| ).
    TRY.
    lv_i = 300.
    lv_x1 = lv_i.
    add( iv_case = 'x1=i 300' iv_value = |{ lv_x1 }| ).
    CATCH cx_root INTO lx.
    exc( iv_case = 'x1=i 300' ix = lx ).
    ENDTRY.
    TRY.
    lv_x8 = '0000000080000000'.
    lv_i = lv_x8.
    add( iv_case = 'i=x8 0000000080000000' iv_value = |{ lv_i }| ).
    CATCH cx_root INTO lx.
    exc( iv_case = 'i=x8 0000000080000000' ix = lx ).
    ENDTRY.
    TRY.
    lv_x8 = 'FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF'.
    lv_i = lv_x8.
    add( iv_case = 'i=x8 FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF' iv_value = |{ lv_i }| ).
    CATCH cx_root INTO lx.
    exc( iv_case = 'i=x8 FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF' ix = lx ).
    ENDTRY.
    TRY.
    lv_x8 = '0102030405060708'.
    lv_i = lv_x8.
    add( iv_case = 'i=x8 0102030405060708' iv_value = |{ lv_i }| ).
    CATCH cx_root INTO lx.
    exc( iv_case = 'i=x8 0102030405060708' ix = lx ).
    ENDTRY.
    lv_i = -1. lv_x8 = lv_i. add( iv_case = 'x8=i -1' iv_value = |{ lv_x8 }| ).
    lv_x8 = '8000000000000000'. lv_8 = lv_x8. add( iv_case = 'int8=x8 8000000000000000' iv_value = |{ lv_8 }| ).
    lv_8 = -1. lv_x8 = lv_8. add( iv_case = 'x8=int8 -1' iv_value = |{ lv_x8 }| ).
    lv_xs = 'FFFFFFFF'. lv_i = lv_xs. add( iv_case = 'i=xstr FFFFFFFF' iv_value = |{ lv_i }| ).
    lv_xs = '0102'. lv_i = lv_xs. add( iv_case = 'i=xstr 0102' iv_value = |{ lv_i }| ).
    CLEAR lv_xs. lv_i = lv_xs. add( iv_case = 'i=xstr empty' iv_value = |{ lv_i }| ).
    lv_i = -1. lv_xs = lv_i. add( iv_case = 'xstr=i -1' iv_value = |{ lv_xs }| ).
    lv_i = 256. lv_xs = lv_i. add( iv_case = 'xstr=i 256' iv_value = |{ lv_xs }| ).
    report( 'P4' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD p5_pack.
    DATA: lv_r   TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2,
          lv_a   TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2,
          lv_b   TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2,
          lv_3   TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 3,
          lv_0   TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 0,
          lv_s   TYPE p LENGTH 2 DECIMALS 0,
          lv_14  TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 14,
          lv_big TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2,
          lv_i   TYPE i,
          lv_f   TYPE f,
          lx     TYPE REF TO cx_root.
    lv_a = 1. lv_b = 3. lv_r = lv_a / lv_b. add( iv_case = '1/3' iv_value = |{ lv_r }| ).
    lv_a = 2. lv_r = lv_a / lv_b. add( iv_case = '2/3' iv_value = |{ lv_r }| ).
    lv_a = -2. lv_r = lv_a / lv_b. add( iv_case = '-2/3' iv_value = |{ lv_r }| ).
    lv_a = 1. lv_r = lv_a / lv_b * lv_b. add( iv_case = '1/3*3' iv_value = |{ lv_r }| ).
    lv_a = 10. lv_b = 4. lv_r = lv_a / lv_b. add( iv_case = '10/4' iv_value = |{ lv_r }| ).
    lv_3 = '0.125'. lv_r = lv_3. add( iv_case = 'p2=0.125' iv_value = |{ lv_r }| ).
    lv_3 = '-0.125'. lv_r = lv_3. add( iv_case = 'p2=-0.125' iv_value = |{ lv_r }| ).
    lv_3 = '0.135'. lv_r = lv_3. add( iv_case = 'p2=0.135' iv_value = |{ lv_r }| ).
    lv_3 = '2.5'. lv_0 = lv_3. add( iv_case = 'p0=2.5' iv_value = |{ lv_0 }| ).
    lv_3 = '-2.5'. lv_0 = lv_3. add( iv_case = 'p0=-2.5' iv_value = |{ lv_0 }| ).
    lv_3 = '3.5'. lv_0 = lv_3. add( iv_case = 'p0=3.5' iv_value = |{ lv_0 }| ).
    lv_3 = '2.5'. lv_i = lv_3. add( iv_case = 'i=p2.5' iv_value = |{ lv_i }| ).
    lv_3 = '-2.5'. lv_i = lv_3. add( iv_case = 'i=p-2.5' iv_value = |{ lv_i }| ).
    TRY.
    lv_s = 999.
    lv_s = lv_s + 1.
    add( iv_case = 'p2.0 999+1' iv_value = |{ lv_s }| ).
    CATCH cx_root INTO lx.
    exc( iv_case = 'p2.0 999+1' ix = lx ).
    ENDTRY.
    TRY.
    lv_s = 999.
    ADD 1 TO lv_s.
    add( iv_case = 'ADD p2.0 999' iv_value = |{ lv_s }| ).
    CATCH cx_root INTO lx.
    exc( iv_case = 'ADD p2.0 999' ix = lx ).
    ENDTRY.
    TRY.
    lv_s = '999.6'.
    add( iv_case = 'p2.0=999.6' iv_value = |{ lv_s }| ).
    CATCH cx_root INTO lx.
    exc( iv_case = 'p2.0=999.6' ix = lx ).
    ENDTRY.
    TRY.
    lv_a = 1.
    lv_b = 0.
    lv_r = lv_a / lv_b.
    add( iv_case = 'p/0' iv_value = |{ lv_r }| ).
    CATCH cx_root INTO lx.
    exc( iv_case = 'p/0' ix = lx ).
    ENDTRY.
    TRY.
    lv_a = 0.
    lv_b = 0.
    lv_r = lv_a / lv_b.
    add( iv_case = 'p0/0' iv_value = |{ lv_r }| ).
    CATCH cx_root INTO lx.
    exc( iv_case = 'p0/0' ix = lx ).
    ENDTRY.
    lv_14 = 1. lv_14 = lv_14 / 7. add( iv_case = 'p14 1/7' iv_value = |{ lv_14 }| ).
    lv_14 = 2. lv_14 = lv_14 / 3. add( iv_case = 'p14 2/3' iv_value = |{ lv_14 }| ).
    TRY.
    lv_big = '99999999999999.99'.
    lv_big = lv_big * lv_big.
    add( iv_case = 'big*big' iv_value = |{ lv_big }| ).
    CATCH cx_root INTO lx.
    exc( iv_case = 'big*big' ix = lx ).
    ENDTRY.
    TRY.
    lv_big = '99999999999999.99'.
    lv_big = lv_big + '0.01'.
    add( iv_case = 'pmax+0.01' iv_value = |{ lv_big }| ).
    CATCH cx_root INTO lx.
    exc( iv_case = 'pmax+0.01' ix = lx ).
    ENDTRY.
    lv_a = '0.1'. lv_b = '0.2'. lv_r = lv_a + lv_b. add( iv_case = '0.1+0.2' iv_value = |{ lv_r }| ).
    lv_a = '1.005'. add( iv_case = 'p2=1.005' iv_value = |{ lv_a }| ).
    lv_f = '1.005'. lv_r = lv_f. add( iv_case = 'p2=f1.005' iv_value = |{ lv_r }| ).
    lv_f = '2.675'. lv_r = lv_f. add( iv_case = 'p2=f2.675' iv_value = |{ lv_r }| ).
    lv_a = 7. lv_b = 2. lv_r = lv_a DIV lv_b. add( iv_case = 'p 7 DIV 2' iv_value = |{ lv_r }| ).
    lv_a = '-7.5'. lv_b = 2. lv_r = lv_a MOD lv_b. add( iv_case = 'p -7.5 MOD 2' iv_value = |{ lv_r }| ).
    lv_a = '2.5'. lv_r = lv_a ** 3. add( iv_case = 'p 2.5**3' iv_value = |{ lv_r }| ).
    lv_r = round( val = '2.345' dec = 2 ). add( iv_case = 'round 2.345' iv_value = |{ lv_r }| ).
    lv_r = '-2.345'. lv_r = round( val = lv_r dec = 1 ). add( iv_case = 'round -2.35/1' iv_value = |{ lv_r }| ).
    report( 'P5' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD p7_gensub.
    DATA: lt_code TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH DEFAULT KEY,
          lv_prog TYPE c LENGTH 40,
          lv_mess TYPE string,
          lv_line TYPE i,
          lv_word TYPE string,
          lv_r    TYPE i,
          lx      TYPE REF TO cx_root.
    APPEND `PROGRAM.` TO lt_code.
    APPEND `FORM f USING p TYPE i CHANGING r TYPE i.` TO lt_code.
    APPEND `  r = p * 2.` TO lt_code.
    APPEND `ENDFORM.` TO lt_code.
    TRY.
        GENERATE SUBROUTINE POOL lt_code NAME lv_prog MESSAGE lv_mess LINE lv_line WORD lv_word.
        add( iv_case = 'good subrc' iv_value = |{ sy-subrc }| ).
        add( iv_case = 'good name' iv_value = |{ lv_prog }| ).
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          PERFORM f IN PROGRAM (lv_prog) USING 21 CHANGING lv_r.
          add( iv_case = 'good perform' iv_value = |{ lv_r }| ).
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_root INTO lx.
        exc( iv_case = 'good' ix = lx ).
    ENDTRY.
    CLEAR: lt_code, lv_prog, lv_mess, lv_line, lv_word.
    APPEND `PROGRAM.` TO lt_code.
    APPEND `FORM f.` TO lt_code.
    APPEND `  undefined_x = 1.` TO lt_code.
    APPEND `ENDFORM.` TO lt_code.
    TRY.
        GENERATE SUBROUTINE POOL lt_code NAME lv_prog MESSAGE lv_mess LINE lv_line WORD lv_word.
        add( iv_case = 'bad subrc' iv_value = |{ sy-subrc }| ).
        add( iv_case = 'bad name' iv_value = |{ lv_prog }| ).
        add( iv_case = 'bad message' iv_value = lv_mess ).
        add( iv_case = 'bad line' iv_value = |{ lv_line }| ).
        add( iv_case = 'bad word' iv_value = lv_word ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO lx.
        exc( iv_case = 'bad' ix = lx ).
    ENDTRY.
    CLEAR: lt_code, lv_prog, lv_mess, lv_line, lv_word.
    APPEND `PROGRAM.` TO lt_code.
    APPEND `FORM f` TO lt_code.
    TRY.
        GENERATE SUBROUTINE POOL lt_code NAME lv_prog MESSAGE lv_mess LINE lv_line WORD lv_word.
        add( iv_case = 'syntax subrc' iv_value = |{ sy-subrc }| ).
        add( iv_case = 'syntax message' iv_value = lv_mess ).
        add( iv_case = 'syntax line' iv_value = |{ lv_line }| ).
        add( iv_case = 'syntax word' iv_value = lv_word ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO lx.
        exc( iv_case = 'syntax' ix = lx ).
    ENDTRY.
    report( 'P7' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD p1_xrepl.
    DATA: lv_base TYPE xstring,
          lv_xs   TYPE xstring,
          lv_w    TYPE xstring,
          lv_xf   TYPE x LENGTH 4,
          lv_rc   TYPE i,
          lx      TYPE REF TO cx_root.
    lv_base = '00112233445566'.
    DEFINE repl.
      TRY.
          lv_xs = lv_base. lv_w = &4.
          REPLACE SECTION OFFSET &2 LENGTH &3 OF lv_xs WITH lv_w IN BYTE MODE.
          lv_rc = sy-subrc.
          add( iv_case = &1 iv_value = |{ lv_xs } rc{ lv_rc }| ).
        CATCH cx_root INTO lx.
          exc( iv_case = &1 ix = lx ).
      ENDTRY.
    END-OF-DEFINITION.
    repl 'same o2l2 AABB' 2 2 'AABB'.
    repl 'shorter o2l3 AA' 2 3 'AA'.
    repl 'longer o2l1 AABBCC' 2 1 'AABBCC'.
    repl 'o0l2 FF' 0 2 'FF'.
    repl 'o5l2 EE (end)' 5 2 'EE'.
    repl 'o7l0 EE (append)' 7 0 'EE'.
    repl 'o6l2 beyond' 6 2 'EE'.
    repl 'o8l0 past end' 8 0 'EE'.
    repl 'o2l2 empty' 2 2 ''.
    repl 'o0l7 all' 0 7 'AB'.
    TRY.
        lv_xf = '00112233'. lv_w = 'AABB'.
        REPLACE SECTION OFFSET 1 LENGTH 1 OF lv_xf WITH lv_w IN BYTE MODE.
        lv_rc = sy-subrc.
        add( iv_case = 'x4 longer' iv_value = |{ lv_xf } rc{ lv_rc }| ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO lx.
        exc( iv_case = 'x4 longer' ix = lx ).
    ENDTRY.
    TRY.
        lv_xf = '00112233'. lv_w = 'AA'.
        REPLACE SECTION OFFSET 1 LENGTH 2 OF lv_xf WITH lv_w IN BYTE MODE.
        lv_rc = sy-subrc.
        add( iv_case = 'x4 shorter' iv_value = |{ lv_xf } rc{ lv_rc }| ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO lx.
        exc( iv_case = 'x4 shorter' ix = lx ).
    ENDTRY.
    report( 'P1' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD p2_xfind.
    DATA: lv_xs  TYPE xstring,
          lv_n1  TYPE x LENGTH 1,
          lv_n2  TYPE x LENGTH 2,
          lv_ne  TYPE xstring,
          lv_off TYPE i,
          lv_len TYPE i,
          lv_cnt TYPE i,
          lt_res TYPE match_result_tab,
          ls_res TYPE match_result,
          lv_all TYPE string,
          lx     TYPE REF TO cx_root.
    lv_xs = 'C3A3C3'.
    lv_n1 = '3C'.
    TRY.
    CLEAR: lv_off, lv_len.
    FIND lv_n1 IN lv_xs IN BYTE MODE MATCH OFFSET lv_off.
    add( iv_case = 'nibble 3C' iv_value = |rc{ sy-subrc } o{ lv_off }| ).
    CATCH cx_root INTO lx.
    exc( iv_case = 'nibble 3C' ix = lx ).
    ENDTRY.
    lv_n1 = 'C3'.
    TRY.
    CLEAR: lv_off, lv_len.
    FIND lv_n1 IN SECTION OFFSET 1 LENGTH 1 OF lv_xs IN BYTE MODE MATCH OFFSET lv_off.
    add( iv_case = 'C3 in o1l1' iv_value = |rc{ sy-subrc } o{ lv_off }| ).
    CATCH cx_root INTO lx.
    exc( iv_case = 'C3 in o1l1' ix = lx ).
    ENDTRY.
    TRY.
    CLEAR: lv_off, lv_len.
    FIND lv_n1 IN SECTION OFFSET 1 LENGTH 2 OF lv_xs IN BYTE MODE MATCH OFFSET lv_off MATCH LENGTH lv_len.
    add( iv_case = 'C3 in o1l2' iv_value = |rc{ sy-subrc } o{ lv_off } l{ lv_len }| ).
    CATCH cx_root INTO lx.
    exc( iv_case = 'C3 in o1l2' ix = lx ).
    ENDTRY.
    TRY.
    CLEAR: lv_off, lv_len.
    FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF lv_n1 IN lv_xs IN BYTE MODE MATCH OFFSET lv_off.
    add( iv_case = 'FIRST C3' iv_value = |rc{ sy-subrc } o{ lv_off }| ).
    CATCH cx_root INTO lx.
    exc( iv_case = 'FIRST C3' ix = lx ).
    ENDTRY.
    TRY.
        CLEAR: lv_cnt, lt_res, lv_all, lv_off.
        FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF lv_n1 IN lv_xs IN BYTE MODE MATCH COUNT lv_cnt RESULTS lt_res.
        LOOP AT lt_res INTO ls_res. lv_all = lv_all && |{ ls_res-offset }/{ ls_res-length } |. ENDLOOP.
        add( iv_case = 'ALL C3' iv_value = |rc{ sy-subrc } n{ lv_cnt } [{ lv_all }]| ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO lx. exc( iv_case = 'ALL C3' ix = lx ).
    ENDTRY.
    TRY.
    CLEAR: lv_off.
    FIND lv_n1 IN SECTION OFFSET 2 LENGTH 5 OF lv_xs IN BYTE MODE MATCH OFFSET lv_off.
    add( iv_case = 'o2l5 past end' iv_value = |rc{ sy-subrc } o{ lv_off }| ).
    CATCH cx_root INTO lx.
    exc( iv_case = 'o2l5 past end' ix = lx ).
    ENDTRY.
    TRY.
    CLEAR: lv_off.
    FIND lv_n1 IN SECTION OFFSET 4 OF lv_xs IN BYTE MODE MATCH OFFSET lv_off.
    add( iv_case = 'o4 past end' iv_value = |rc{ sy-subrc } o{ lv_off }| ).
    CATCH cx_root INTO lx.
    exc( iv_case = 'o4 past end' ix = lx ).
    ENDTRY.
    TRY.
    CLEAR: lv_off.
    FIND lv_n1 IN SECTION OFFSET 3 OF lv_xs IN BYTE MODE MATCH OFFSET lv_off.
    add( iv_case = 'o3 at end' iv_value = |rc{ sy-subrc } o{ lv_off }| ).
    CATCH cx_root INTO lx.
    exc( iv_case = 'o3 at end' ix = lx ).
    ENDTRY.
    TRY.
    CLEAR: lv_off.
    FIND lv_ne IN lv_xs IN BYTE MODE MATCH OFFSET lv_off.
    add( iv_case = 'empty needle' iv_value = |rc{ sy-subrc } o{ lv_off }| ).
    CATCH cx_root INTO lx.
    exc( iv_case = 'empty needle' ix = lx ).
    ENDTRY.
    lv_n2 = 'A3C3'.
    TRY.
    CLEAR: lv_off.
    FIND lv_n2 IN SECTION OFFSET 0 LENGTH 2 OF lv_xs IN BYTE MODE MATCH OFFSET lv_off.
    add( iv_case = 'A3C3 in o0l2' iv_value = |rc{ sy-subrc } o{ lv_off }| ).
    CATCH cx_root INTO lx.
    exc( iv_case = 'A3C3 in o0l2' ix = lx ).
    ENDTRY.
    TRY.
    CLEAR: lv_off.
    FIND lv_n2 IN SECTION OFFSET 0 LENGTH 3 OF lv_xs IN BYTE MODE MATCH OFFSET lv_off.
    add( iv_case = 'A3C3 in o0l3' iv_value = |rc{ sy-subrc } o{ lv_off }| ).
    CATCH cx_root INTO lx.
    exc( iv_case = 'A3C3 in o0l3' ix = lx ).
    ENDTRY.
    report( 'P2' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
